major_cooldowns.name: Combustion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it for the first 18 seconds while Firestarter is up, activate it off the global right before a hard cast lands, spend every Fire Blast charge inside the window, and fill with Scorch between your Hot Streak Pyroblasts.

major_cooldowns.name: Meteor
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it just before you activate Combustion or in the last 8 seconds of the window, and hold it for a pack when several targets are about to be up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 153561 is the cast id in all five sampled parses; the same-name 117588 row lists a 60s base cooldown and was never cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Emberwing Heatwave
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it once Combustion is running, or in the last seconds of the fight when another window will not come.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1250508 is the on-use cast of the Emberwing Feather trinket, the emberwing_feather item the action list times to buff.combustion.remains>6. talent_gated suppresses a never-used error for players without the trinket.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on the raid's called lust and line your Combustion up with the haste.
major_cooldowns.id_note: talent_gated is set because raid lust is assigned to one player; three of the five sampled parses never cast it.

rule.description: Pyroblast spends Hot Streak the moment it procs
rule.action: Queue the instant Pyroblast as your current cast ends, or Flamestrike when you are on several targets.

rule.description: Meteor lands inside your Combustion window
rule.action: Cast Meteor right before you press Combustion, or inside the window so it lands while your crits are guaranteed.

rule.description: Pyroblast fills every cast during Hyperthermia
rule.action: Chain the free instant Pyroblasts through the window instead of starting another hard cast.
Move your Hot Streak spender onto Flamestrike from 3 targets as Sunfury or 4 as Frostfire, and stay on Pyroblast while Firestarter is up.
